status: Research only. Not imported by the application.
scope: Curated candidate list, not an exhaustive DSM reproduction, diagnostic instrument or approved case bank.
edition_basis: DSM-5-TR (2022), with public APA update index and September 2025 cumulative supplement checked; selected DSM-5 materials identified separately.

tier_legend.A: Proposed first authoring wave; review and case validation still required
tier_legend.B: Expanded authoring wave; additional course/specifier research required
tier_legend.C: Specialist case authoring or evidence/interface gaps; not a judgment about patients
tier_legend.D: Separate ICD-11 comparison, not a DSM-5-TR selectable diagnosis

field_notes.clinical_summary: Brief sourced paraphrase, not complete criteria
field_notes.history_requirement: Selected factual anchors plus explicit verification gaps, not an automatic diagnostic rule
field_notes.suggested_profile_stages: Original scope recommendation for initial fictional cases, not all clinically possible ages
field_notes.interview_focus: Original educational authoring suggestion informed by cited sources
field_notes.differential_or_limit: Research distinction or original simulation constraint; never an exhaustive differential

entries.name: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Persistent inattention and/or hyperactivity-impulsivity that interferes with functioning.
entries.history_requirement: At least six months; childhood symptoms before 12; evidence in multiple settings.
entries.interview_focus: Daily organization and school/work examples; caregiver or school collateral.
entries.differential_or_limit: Sleep, anxiety, depression and learning difficulties can resemble attention problems. Toddlers are not a default ADHD case.

entries.name: Autism spectrum disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Developmental differences in social communication alongside restricted or repetitive patterns.
entries.history_requirement: Earlier developmental history is essential; recent events cannot create autism.
entries.interview_focus: Communication preferences, routines, sensory needs, strengths and support.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not infer intellectual disability, lack of empathy or one universal speech style.

entries.name: Specific learning disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Persistent difficulties in reading, writing or mathematics.
entries.history_requirement: Difficulties despite targeted assistance for at least six months; educational history.
entries.interview_focus: Learning demands, support, school records and individual strengths.
entries.differential_or_limit: Language exposure, teaching opportunity and sensory conditions need consideration; not an IQ guess.

entries.name: Language disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Developmental difficulties acquiring and using language.
entries.history_requirement: Developmental and language-assessment history; no synthetic diagnosis from a short transcript.
entries.interview_focus: Caregiver observations, comprehension and communication support.
entries.differential_or_limit: NIDCD's developmental language disorder terminology is related, not an automatic DSM equivalence; hearing and multilingual context matter.

entries.name: Intellectual developmental disorder (intellectual disability)
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Intellectual and adaptive-functioning limitations beginning during development.
entries.history_requirement: Prior developmental assessment and everyday support needs, not fabricated test scores.
entries.interview_focus: Practical, social and communication supports; accessible interview.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not equate limited speech with low intelligence or use the older adult profile to imply developmental disability.

entries.name: Tourette's disorder (Tourette syndrome)
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A childhood-onset pattern involving motor and vocal tics.
entries.history_requirement: Tic history over a year and onset before adulthood; verify exact manual wording.
entries.interview_focus: Tic course, discomfort, functioning and co-occurring concerns.
entries.differential_or_limit: Text alone cannot display motor findings; swearing is not a required feature.

entries.name: Major depressive disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: An impairing depressive episode involving low mood or reduced interest, with associated changes.
entries.history_requirement: A major depressive episode has a two-week duration anchor; evaluate the broader mood history.
entries.interview_focus: Sleep, interests, energy, functioning, onset and safety.
entries.differential_or_limit: Consider bipolar episodes, medical/substance effects and grief. A sadness slider is insufficient.

entries.name: Persistent depressive disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A sustained depressive course rather than one brief low-mood episode.
entries.history_requirement: Adult history generally spans at least two years; child/adolescent rules require manual verification.
entries.interview_focus: Long-term baseline, periods of improvement and functioning.
entries.differential_or_limit: A 90-day log cannot establish a chronic course; distinguish superimposed episodes.

entries.name: Disruptive mood dysregulation disorder (DMDD)
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Severe recurrent outbursts with persistent irritability between them.
entries.history_requirement: At least a year; onset before 10; first diagnosis not before 6 or after 18 in APA's rule.
entries.interview_focus: Caregiver/teacher observations across settings and baseline mood.
entries.differential_or_limit: Differentiate episodic mania and other explanations. Do not automatically combine with ODD; age-summary discrepancy documented.

entries.name: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A recurring, impairing mood pattern related to the menstrual cycle.
entries.history_requirement: Document cycle relationship; exact prospective confirmation rules remain to be checked.
entries.interview_focus: Symptoms across cycles and intervals, functioning and relevant physiology.
entries.differential_or_limit: Stage and name alone cannot establish menstruation; distinguish exacerbation of another condition.

entries.name: Bipolar I disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A history of mania; depressive episodes may also occur.
entries.history_requirement: Mania usually at least seven days, or shorter when hospitalization is necessary; full episode review required.
entries.interview_focus: Episode changes in sleep need, energy, behavior and functioning.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not ordinary daily mood swings; consider substances, medical causes and psychosis chronology.

entries.name: Bipolar II disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Hypomanic and major depressive episodes, without a manic episode.
entries.history_requirement: Author separate past episodes; confirm exact hypomania duration and exclusions against the manual.
entries.interview_focus: Recognizing less obvious elevated-energy periods alongside depression.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not simply a milder version of bipolar I; current depression alone does not distinguish it.

entries.name: Cyclothymic disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A chronic pattern of subthreshold elevated and depressive symptoms.
entries.history_requirement: Longitudinal course required; exact adult/youth duration rules await full-manual verification.
entries.interview_focus: Baseline fluctuation and distinction from full mood episodes.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not produce alternating hourly moods and label them cyclothymia.

entries.name: Generalized anxiety disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Difficult-to-control worry across areas of life with interference.
entries.history_requirement: Most days over at least six months; age-specific symptom counts must be verified.
entries.interview_focus: Worry topics, control, bodily tension, sleep and functioning.
entries.differential_or_limit: Ordinary stress, other anxiety presentations, substances and medical conditions.

entries.name: Panic disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks with ongoing concern or behavior change.
entries.history_requirement: At least a month of subsequent worry or change; document recurrent attacks.
entries.interview_focus: Attack timing, unexpectedness, anticipatory fear and avoidance.
entries.differential_or_limit: An isolated attack is not panic disorder; medical explanations remain possible.

entries.name: Social anxiety disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Fear of scrutiny or negative evaluation that restricts participation.
entries.history_requirement: At least six months with meaningful interference.
entries.interview_focus: Situations avoided, feared evaluation, desired relationships and school/work impact.
entries.differential_or_limit: Differentiate ordinary shyness, communication differences and body-image concerns.

entries.name: Specific phobia
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Focused fear and avoidance around a particular object or situation.
entries.history_requirement: Persistent course required; exact criteria and duration need manual review.
entries.interview_focus: Authored feared situation, avoidance and practical interference.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not pathologize developmentally ordinary fears or actual danger.

entries.name: Agoraphobia
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Avoidance linked to difficulty escaping or obtaining help in feared situations.
entries.history_requirement: Document distinct situation types and persistent course; verify full criteria.
entries.interview_focus: Travel, queues, open/enclosed places, going out and available support.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not synonymous with staying home, and not dependent on having panic disorder.

entries.name: Separation anxiety disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Developmentally excessive separation fears that interfere with life.
entries.history_requirement: Age-specific duration and developmental expectations require verification.
entries.interview_focus: Separation circumstances, school attendance, family observations and impairment.
entries.differential_or_limit: Toddler separation distress can be ordinary development; do not infer a disorder from it.

entries.name: Selective mutism
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Anxiety-linked inability to speak in certain situations despite speaking elsewhere.
entries.history_requirement: Document the pattern across people/settings; verify duration and language exclusions.
entries.interview_focus: Caregiver/teacher accounts, communication access and low-pressure interaction.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not deliberate defiance; a fluent chatbot alone would misrepresent the presentation.

entries.name: Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD)
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Intrusive unwanted thoughts and/or driven rituals that are time-consuming or impairing.
entries.history_requirement: Document recurring pattern and interference; do not invent a six-month threshold.
entries.interview_focus: Meaning of rituals, feared consequences, mental rituals and daily impact.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not mere neatness; unwanted intrusive thoughts are not the person's intentions.

entries.name: Body dysmorphic disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Distressing appearance preoccupation with repeated checking or comparison.
entries.history_requirement: Persistent preoccupation, repetitive behavior and impairment must be authored.
entries.interview_focus: Time spent, avoidance and social impact.
entries.differential_or_limit: Differentiate eating-related weight/shape concerns; avoid appearance reassurance loops.

entries.name: Hoarding disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Difficulty discarding possessions leading to compromised living space.
entries.history_requirement: Longstanding accumulation and functional impact; a week cannot create an established clutter history.
entries.interview_focus: Use of rooms, attachment to items and daily tasks.
entries.differential_or_limit: Differentiate ordinary collecting and cognitive or medical contributors.

entries.name: Trichotillomania (hair-pulling disorder)
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Recurrent hair pulling with consequences and difficulty stopping.
entries.history_requirement: Author the course, attempts to stop and impact; exact exclusions need checking.
entries.interview_focus: Patterns, awareness, distress and social effects.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not make it a moral failure or equate it automatically with suicidal self-injury.

entries.name: Excoriation (skin-picking) disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Repeated skin picking causing lesions and unsuccessful efforts to stop.
entries.history_requirement: Pattern and impairment, with medical and other explanations considered.
entries.interview_focus: Triggers, awareness, impact and care already sought.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not generate injury instructions or assume every skin problem is psychiatric.

entries.name: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Trauma-linked intrusion, avoidance, arousal and changes in mood/cognition.
entries.history_requirement: Symptoms longer than one month; qualifying exposure and onset chronology are separate facts.
entries.interview_focus: Current effects and functioning, with non-graphic trauma history.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not every stressful event meets the exposure requirement; preschool criteria differ.

entries.name: Acute stress disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: An impairing post-trauma reaction within the early time window.
entries.history_requirement: Three days to one month after trauma.
entries.interview_focus: Recent course, dissociation, distress and available support.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not relabel all immediate reactions as PTSD or force later PTSD development.

entries.name: Adjustment disorders
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Distress or impairment associated with an identifiable stressor.
entries.history_requirement: Begins within three months; ordinarily ends within six months after the stressor/consequences end.
entries.interview_focus: Stressor, coping, supports and changes in functioning.
entries.differential_or_limit: Differentiate ordinary adjustment and another disorder better explaining symptoms.

entries.name: Prolonged grief disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Persistent disabling grief beyond expected cultural context.
entries.history_requirement: Loss at least 12 months earlier in adults or six months in children/adolescents.
entries.interview_focus: Longing/preoccupation, daily functioning, meaning and cultural context.
entries.differential_or_limit: Grief alone is not illness; introduced as a DSM-5-TR diagnosis, not an original DSM-5 Section II label.

entries.name: Reactive attachment disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: An early-childhood attachment-related presentation associated with severely insufficient care.
entries.history_requirement: Requires a specific developmental and caregiving history; exact age rules unresolved here.
entries.interview_focus: Caregiver collateral and observed comfort-seeking/response.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not a synonym for insecure attachment or a conclusion from one caregiver interaction.

entries.name: Disinhibited social engagement disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: An attachment-related pattern of unusually indiscriminate social approach.
entries.history_requirement: Requires severe insufficient-care history and developmental criteria.
entries.interview_focus: Observed interactions with unfamiliar adults and caregiving chronology.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not simply being friendly; never invent neglect from personality traits.

entries.name: Depersonalization/derealization disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Recurring or persistent detachment experiences with reality testing retained.
entries.history_requirement: Author course and exclusions; no universal synthetic day threshold.
entries.interview_focus: Detachment, insight, distress and functioning.
entries.differential_or_limit: Distinguish psychosis, substances and neurological explanations.

entries.name: Dissociative amnesia
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Autobiographical memory gaps beyond ordinary forgetting.
entries.history_requirement: Specific missing periods and preserved knowledge must be authored.
entries.interview_focus: Scope of memory difficulty and relevant medical history.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not fill gaps with invented recovered memories or assumed abuse.

entries.name: Dissociative identity disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Disruptions in identity and memory requiring careful differential assessment.
entries.history_requirement: Longitudinal evidence and explicit memory boundaries; not randomly changing personalities.
entries.interview_focus: Patient-described discontinuity, memory gaps and functioning.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not conflate with schizophrenia or portray theatrical automatic switching.

entries.name: Somatic symptom disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Distressing bodily symptoms accompanied by disproportionate symptom-related thoughts or behavior.
entries.history_requirement: Document persistent concern and impairment; verify precise duration wording.
entries.interview_focus: Symptoms, meaning, care history and effects on everyday life.
entries.differential_or_limit: Symptoms are real; medical illness can coexist. Normal tests alone are not a diagnosis.

entries.name: Illness anxiety disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Preoccupation with serious illness when somatic symptoms are absent or limited.
entries.history_requirement: Longer-term pattern needed; exact threshold not verified here.
entries.interview_focus: Checking, reassurance seeking or medical avoidance and disruption.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not dismiss new symptoms or assume avoidance means lack of concern.

entries.name: Functional neurological symptom disorder (conversion disorder)
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A DSM-5-TR diagnostic category with updated terminology.
entries.history_requirement: Neurological assessment evidence is needed before authoring a confirmed diagnosis.
entries.interview_focus: History and impact, with authored examination information supplied separately.
entries.differential_or_limit: This search verified terminology, not a complete criteria/evidence package. Chat cannot replace examination.
entries.coverage: Naming verified; disorder-specific clinical research incomplete

entries.name: Anorexia nervosa
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Restrictive eating with low weight in context and weight/shape-related disturbance.
entries.history_requirement: Course, growth/weight context and medical assessment must be authored.
entries.interview_focus: Daily functioning, eating concerns and medical care history.
entries.differential_or_limit: No procedural weight-loss content; appearance alone cannot establish a diagnosis.

entries.name: Bulimia nervosa
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Binge episodes accompanied by compensatory behavior.
entries.history_requirement: Document episode frequency and duration; verify full DSM thresholds.
entries.interview_focus: Loss of control, distress and daily impact without procedural details.
entries.differential_or_limit: Differentiate binge-eating disorder and anorexia presentations; medical complications matter.

entries.name: Binge-eating disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Repeated distressing binge episodes without the regular compensatory pattern of bulimia.
entries.history_requirement: Verify frequency and duration against the manual before case approval.
entries.interview_focus: Loss of control, context, distress and impact.
entries.differential_or_limit: Body size alone is not the diagnosis; avoid moral judgments about eating.

entries.name: Avoidant/restrictive food intake disorder (ARFID)
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Restricted intake associated with sensory concerns, low interest or feared consequences, with significant impact.
entries.history_requirement: Feeding/developmental history and consequences; psychosocial interference may qualify without low weight.
entries.interview_focus: Caregiver observations, accepted foods, participation and available assessment.
entries.differential_or_limit: Distinguish ordinary picky eating and medical causes; not driven by the anorexia-style weight/shape concern.

entries.name: Enuresis
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Recurrent urinary wetting considered in developmental and medical context.
entries.history_requirement: Toileting development, frequency and persistence; exact DSM gates need checking.
entries.interview_focus: Caregiver history, sleep, functioning and non-shaming discussion.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not assign this diagnosis to ordinary toddler accidents.

entries.name: Encopresis
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Recurrent fecal soiling requiring developmental and bowel-history assessment.
entries.history_requirement: Document toileting history, constipation and course; verify full diagnostic gates.
entries.interview_focus: Caregiver observations, discomfort, school impact and medical review.
entries.differential_or_limit: Avoid blame; a mental-health interview cannot exclude bowel disease.

entries.name: Insomnia disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Difficulty initiating or maintaining sleep with daytime consequences despite opportunity to sleep.
entries.history_requirement: Common chronic anchor: at least three nights weekly for at least three months.
entries.interview_focus: Sleep schedule, opportunity, daytime effect and other sleep symptoms.
entries.differential_or_limit: A short sleep diary is not the total disorder duration; consider circadian and breathing problems.

entries.name: Oppositional defiant disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: An impairing pattern of oppositional or irritable behavior requiring contextual assessment.
entries.history_requirement: Persistent, developmentally unusual pattern; verify duration/frequency and exclusion rules.
entries.interview_focus: Across-setting examples, antecedents, relationships and collateral.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not confuse communication difficulty, fear or situational conflict with a disorder.

entries.name: Conduct disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A persistent serious behavior pattern affecting others' rights or major norms.
entries.history_requirement: Longitudinal examples and differential assessment; exact gates require manual review.
entries.interview_focus: Context, consequences, developmental history and strengths.
entries.differential_or_limit: Avoid criminality stereotypes, invented offenses or using diagnosis to predict an individual's violence.

entries.name: Alcohol use disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Impaired control over alcohol use with distress or harmful consequences.
entries.history_requirement: Symptoms assessed within a 12-month window; this does not require uninterrupted use for a year.
entries.interview_focus: Control, responsibilities, attempts to reduce and care history.
entries.differential_or_limit: Quantity alone does not establish the disorder; withdrawal can require medical care.

entries.name: Cannabis use disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A substance-specific pattern of impaired control and harmful consequences.
entries.history_requirement: Substance-specific criteria and chronology need verification; distinguish use, intoxication and withdrawal.
entries.interview_focus: Use pattern, concentration, functioning and attempts to reduce.
entries.differential_or_limit: Exposure or medically supervised physiological dependence alone is not enough; avoid invented doses or detox advice.

entries.name: Opioid use disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A substance-specific pattern of impaired control and harmful consequences.
entries.history_requirement: Substance-specific criteria and chronology need verification; distinguish use, intoxication and withdrawal.
entries.interview_focus: Control, consequences, treatment history and access to support.
entries.differential_or_limit: Exposure or medically supervised physiological dependence alone is not enough; avoid invented doses or detox advice.

entries.name: Stimulant use disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A substance-specific pattern of impaired control and harmful consequences.
entries.history_requirement: Substance-specific criteria and chronology need verification; distinguish use, intoxication and withdrawal.
entries.interview_focus: Use pattern, sleep, mood/psychotic symptoms and functional change.
entries.differential_or_limit: Exposure or medically supervised physiological dependence alone is not enough; avoid invented doses or detox advice.

entries.name: Sedative, hypnotic, or anxiolytic use disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A substance-specific pattern of impaired control and harmful consequences.
entries.history_requirement: Substance-specific criteria and chronology need verification; distinguish use, intoxication and withdrawal.
entries.interview_focus: Prescribed/non-prescribed context, loss of control and medical history.
entries.differential_or_limit: Exposure or medically supervised physiological dependence alone is not enough; avoid invented doses or detox advice.

entries.name: Tobacco use disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A substance-specific pattern of impaired control and harmful consequences.
entries.history_requirement: Substance-specific criteria and chronology need verification; distinguish use, intoxication and withdrawal.
entries.interview_focus: Dependence-related pattern, triggers, attempts to stop and functioning.
entries.differential_or_limit: Exposure or medically supervised physiological dependence alone is not enough; avoid invented doses or detox advice.

entries.name: Gambling disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Repeated gambling with impaired control and consequential harm.
entries.history_requirement: Past-year pattern, not a single bet or loss.
entries.interview_focus: Impact on time, relationships, finances and attempts to stop.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not provide betting strategies or use financial loss alone as diagnosis.

entries.name: Schizophrenia
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Psychotic, negative and cognitive features with a characteristic course and impairment.
entries.history_requirement: Overall disturbance at least six months, with active-phase requirements and exceptions checked separately.
entries.interview_focus: Subjective experience, functioning, mood and medical/substance chronology.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not DID and not automatic violence; distinguish reported perceptions from objective world facts.

entries.name: Schizophreniform disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Schizophrenia-like presentation distinguished partly by shorter duration.
entries.history_requirement: At least one month and less than six months; follow-up can change the formulation.
entries.interview_focus: Onset, symptom course, functioning and competing explanations.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not a conclusion from one strange statement; longer-term outcome cannot be assumed.

entries.name: Brief psychotic disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A distinct brief psychotic diagnostic category.
entries.history_requirement: Exact duration, return-to-baseline and exclusion requirements need dedicated verification.
entries.interview_focus: Onset, course, recovery and medical/substance information.
entries.differential_or_limit: Name verified; do not instantiate until the full course is authored.

entries.name: Delusional disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A separate psychotic disorder requiring careful assessment of belief, context and functioning.
entries.history_requirement: Exact duration and exclusions require full-manual review.
entries.interview_focus: Belief-related experience, impact, cultural context and collateral.
entries.differential_or_limit: Do not classify unfamiliar cultural or religious beliefs as delusions.
entries.coverage: Taxonomy and update verified; detailed criteria research incomplete

entries.name: Schizoaffective disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A distinct diagnosis involving both psychotic and mood features across time.
entries.history_requirement: Must author relative timing of mood and psychosis; complete rules not verified in this search.
entries.interview_focus: Longitudinal episode map, not current symptoms alone.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not shorthand for any combination of depression and hallucinations.
entries.coverage: Taxonomy verified; detailed criteria research incomplete

entries.name: Delirium
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Acute fluctuating changes in attention and awareness with medical context.
entries.history_requirement: Hours-to-days change from baseline; fluctuations matter.
entries.interview_focus: Collateral baseline, medicines, acute illness and orientation.
entries.differential_or_limit: Requires a medical-assessment training scenario, not ordinary stable outpatient role-play.

entries.name: Mild neurocognitive disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Acquired cognitive decline with everyday independence largely maintained.
entries.history_requirement: Evidence of decline from prior functioning; testing and etiology context needed.
entries.interview_focus: Compensatory strategies, daily tasks and informant comparison.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not ordinary ageing or automatically Alzheimer's disease; MCI and DSM labels are not a universal code crosswalk.

entries.name: Major neurocognitive disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Acquired cognitive decline that interferes with independent daily functioning.
entries.history_requirement: Author premorbid baseline, course, cause and assessment evidence.
entries.interview_focus: Patient plus informant, everyday abilities and support.
entries.differential_or_limit: Older age alone cannot assign dementia; avoid inventing cognitive-test results.

entries.name: Borderline personality disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A longstanding pattern involving emotion regulation, self-image and relationships.
entries.history_requirement: Longitudinal pattern, not a brief crisis. Youth cases need separate specialist review.
entries.interview_focus: Relational history, distress, goals and functioning.
entries.differential_or_limit: Avoid 'manipulative patient' scripts; differentiate episodic bipolar symptoms and trauma-related conditions.

entries.name: Avoidant personality disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A longstanding pattern of social inhibition and rejection sensitivity with impairment.
entries.history_requirement: Pervasive pattern across contexts; not inferred from a recent anxious week.
entries.interview_focus: Relationships, self-perception and desired participation.
entries.differential_or_limit: Compare social anxiety and cultural context; ordinary introversion is not a disorder.

entries.name: Obsessive-compulsive personality disorder
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: A longstanding rigid pattern around order, perfection and control.
entries.history_requirement: Pervasive developmental history and impairment must be established.
entries.interview_focus: Flexibility, task completion, relationships and personal goals.
entries.differential_or_limit: Distinct from OCD; conscientiousness alone is not psychopathology.

entries.name: Gender dysphoria
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Clinically significant distress or impairment related to gender incongruence.
entries.history_requirement: Age/puberty-specific criteria and persistence require appropriate review.
entries.interview_focus: Patient-defined distress, identity, support and functioning.
entries.differential_or_limit: Transgender or gender-diverse identity itself is not a disorder; no assumptions from pronouns.

entries.name: Complex PTSD — ICD-11 comparison
entries.classification: ICD-11; not a separate DSM-5-TR diagnosis
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: ICD-11 PTSD with additional difficulties in emotion regulation, self-concept and relationships.
entries.history_requirement: Use a distinct ICD-11 framework; do not mix criteria sets.
entries.interview_focus: Trauma-related functioning and disturbances in self-organization.
entries.differential_or_limit: Not a separate DSM-5-TR diagnosis; prolonged trauma alone does not establish it.

entries.name: Gaming disorder — ICD-11 comparison
entries.classification: ICD-11; DSM-5-TR Internet Gaming Disorder is further-study
entries.research_status: Research candidate only; not implemented or clinically approved
entries.stage_scope: Proposed starting case scope, not an epidemiological or diagnostic age restriction
entries.clinical_summary: Impaired gaming control with priority over other activities and significant harm.
entries.history_requirement: Normally a 12-month pattern in WHO's overview; use the full ICD-11 requirements.
entries.interview_focus: Functioning and control, not screen time alone.
entries.differential_or_limit: DSM-5-TR Internet Gaming Disorder is a further-study condition, not an equivalent established DSM diagnosis.
